// DiagData: CAN ID 0x400 (standard), 8 bytes, sender Tester
// Diagnostic data message.
// Second line of this comment.
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[7] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// MuxSelector: start bit 0, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 255, multiplexor
MuxSelector_raw = data[0]
MuxSelector = MuxSelector_raw

// SensorVoltage: start bit 8, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.001, offset 0, range 0 .. 65.535 V, when MuxSelector == 0
if MuxSelector_raw == 0:
    SensorVoltage_raw = data[1] | (data[2] << 8)
    SensorVoltage = SensorVoltage_raw * 0.001

// SensorCurrent: start bit 8, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.01, offset 0, range 0 .. 655.35 A, when MuxSelector == 1
if MuxSelector_raw == 1:
    SensorCurrent_raw = data[1] | (data[2] << 8)
    SensorCurrent = SensorCurrent_raw * 0.01

// ErrorCode: start bit 8, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 65535, when MuxSelector == 2
// values: 0 = "No error", 1 = "Sensor short to ground", 2 = "Sensor short to battery", 3 = "Sensor open circuit"
if MuxSelector_raw == 2:
    ErrorCode_raw = data[1] | (data[2] << 8)
    ErrorCode = ErrorCode_raw
